answer: The horizon index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1283 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the mirror. Flooding registration pushes a hostile operator to the back of the summit queue while honest participants promoted earlier goes on earning. That is 25 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
